description: Return the running kObsidian server's package name, semver version, host runtime (`bun` or `node`), and runtime version. Use this as a health-check or to confirm which server build a client is talking to. Read-only; zero side effects.
name: system.version

name.description: npm package name of the running server.

runtime.description: Which runtime is executing the server.

runtimeVersion.description: Version of the runtime (bun or node).

summary.description: Human-readable one-liner combining the fields above.

title: Server Version
